profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Alaska Airlines
profile.summary: As a Principal Software Engineer at Alaska Airlines, I lead the Service Quality and Reliability team within ITS Middleware Services. I work closely with various teams across the Middleware and Data Services organization to ensure the reliability and accuracy of our data and applications.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead the Service Quality and Reliability Team for Middleware Services

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer on the Middleware Team at Alaska Airlines.
Acting Product owner for GDS Team.
Prioritizes and manages backlog of work for the Middleware Development Team.
Runs Scrum ceremonies. 
Create Sumo Logic Dashboard to monitor applications owned by the team.
Collaborates with dependent teams in resolving production issues and defects.
Communicates with dependent teams on needs for future services and coordinates the work.

positions.title: Software Engineer II / Acting Product owner
positions.description:
Software Engineer II on the Middleware Team at Alaska Airlines as well as acting Product Owner
Prioritizes and manages backlog of work for the Middleware Development Team.
Create Sumo Logic Dashboard to monitor applications owned by the team.
Collaborates with dependent teams in resolving production issues and defects.
Communicates with dependent teams on needs for future services and coordinates the work.

positions.title: Assistant to Carla Faini at Microsoft
positions.description: Conduct research, enter data, proofread documents, beta test technical educational materials, prepare expense reports, order supplies, make travel arrangements, calendaring, distribute marketing collateral and perform other clerical tasks.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
Supervise all aspects of branch operations including: manage and train tellers; perform audits; work with senior executives, calendar management for the branch. 
Meet customers banking needs. Maintain complete confidentiality for individual and corporate clients; provide on-the-spot solutions; interact diplomatically with customers with financial difficulties.  Reconcile accounts; set up new accounts; process loan applications and fund loans. 
Excellent computer skills: multiple banking software packages; Microsoft Office Suite.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Information Technology Web and Mobile Development

volunteerExperiences.description: Cook, serve and clean up breakfast for before school breakfast program

Camp counselor for children at Royal Family Kids Camp, a camp for children in the foster system.

1 week each Summer 2003-2008
